the glycerol effect is specific for plasmids, and that glycerol does not stimulate the uptake of DNA but rather the release from transformasomes of plasmid molecules that have already been taken into the recipient cells.

glycerol treatment can be used to release plasmid DNA from transformasomes and thereby increase the efficiency of plasmid transformation in H. influenzae.
